summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, and the party is now the market's favoured side. The Democrats Josh Turek in [[Iowa]], Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]] and Sherrod Brown in [[Ohio]] each gained a lot of ground, and the market lists all three as predicted flips. In Nebraska, the Republican Pete Ricketts saw a sharp drop in their chances.
summaries.governor: The biggest moves came in [[Nevada]] and [[Kansas]], both marked as predicted flips: the Democrat Aaron Ford gained ground sharply in Nevada, while the Republican Ty Masterson saw a steep drop in Kansas. In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds also strengthened considerably. Vermont's Republican, Phil Scott, slipped noticeably in the Polymarket odds.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds moved moderately further toward the Democrats winning control of the House, which the market already favours them to do. In [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]], the Democrat J. D. Ford gained sharply on Republican Victoria Spartz, and in [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]] the Democrat Paul Barringer also made a sharp gain against Republican Brad Knott; both are predicted flips.
